author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನಿನ್ನನೀನೇನೆಂದು ತಿಳಿದಿರುವೆ ಮಾನವನೆ
ನಿನ್ನ ಸೀಮಿತ ಪರಿಧಿ ಅರಿತಿರುವೆಯೇನು
ನಿನ್ನ ನಾಲಿಗೆಯೊಡನೆ ನಡೆನುಡಿಯು ಹಿಡಿತವಿರೆ
ನಿನ್ನ ಜಗ ಸುಂದರವು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: What do you take yourself to be, O man?
do you know your own limited reach?
when your words and deeds are held in check along with your tongue,
your world becomes beautiful, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We tend to overestimate ourselves. Know your limits, rein in your tongue and your conduct, and life around you becomes beautiful.
